List of Exclusions
A. Excluded healthcare services
1. Healthcare Services which are not medically necessary
2. All expenses relating to dental treatment, dental prostheses, and orthodontic treatments.
3. Care for the sake of travelling.
4. Custodial care including I) Non-medical treatment services; 2) Health-related services which do not seek to improve or which do not result in a change in the medical condition of the patient
